messages.subject: Ironhold - directors' duties advice note
messages.plaintextBody:
Andrew, Robert, Patricia,

Ahead of the board meeting to approve the restructuring, I attach a note on the directors' duties that are engaged - in particular the shift towards creditors' interests and the wrongful-trading and connected-party points arising from the shareholder debt-for-equity conversion. Happy to attend the board to walk through it.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
